# Statement coverage of each file of the main package before its code moves
# into packages: covered/total statements and the share. A PR that moves
# code out of a file keeps the moved code covered at least this well.
# Measured on macOS (so the darwin-only files and tests count) with rclone
# installed and without the site's node_modules, whose tests skip. Paths
# that depend on timing move a count between runs, debounce.go's by up to
# seven statements; each count is the best of several runs. Remake it with:
#
#   go test -count=1 -coverprofile=cover.out ./... && awk -F'[: ,]' 'NR > 1 { f = $1; n = $(NF-1); total[f] += n; all += n; if ($NF > 0) { cov[f] += n; covered += n } } END { for (f in total) printf "%-28s %5d/%-5d %5.1f%%\n", f, cov[f], total[f], 100 * cov[f] / total[f]; printf "%-28s %5d/%-5d %5.1f%%\n", "total", covered, all, 100 * covered / all }' cover.out | sort
#
